text: {"lessons":["I sold every stock for a gain early on, but locking in a profit felt good without showing that selling was the best decision for my account.","After those sales I made no trades for seven periods and my account value stayed flat; I should review whether my cash and remaining holdings still fit my goals instead of letting inaction decide.","I should not treat average cost, recent price moves, or daily account checks as reliable reasons to trade; I will make decisions based on each holding’s prospects and my overall plan."]}
